title: polystichum brachypterum
intro: Polystichum brachypterum, commonly known as the short-fronded shield fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, thanks to its ability to act as an expectorant and cough suppressant. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum brachypterum include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
